ONTARIO SUPERIOR COURT OF JUSTICE - SMALL CLAIMS COURT
Toronto Small Claims Court
Claim No. SC-26-000000
PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM (Form 7A)
Plaintiff: Greenline Holdings (fictional)
Defendant: Luz Marina Castillo
The plaintiff claims $4,250.00 for unpaid rent and damage to the rental unit at Apt 401, 210 Sherbourne Street, plus costs.
TO THE DEFENDANT: If you wish to dispute this claim, you must file a Defence (Form 9A) with the court within 20 calendar days after you were served with this claim. If you do not, judgment may be obtained against you without further notice.
Date served: September 8, 2026
